elements.requirement: The Commissioner must prepare and publish a strategic plan as soon as reasonably practicable after the Commissioner's appointment.
elements.quote: The Commissioner must, as soon as reasonably practicable after the Commissioner's appointment, prepare and publish a strategic plan.

elements.requirement: A strategic plan is defined as a plan setting out how the Commissioner proposes to exercise the Commissioner's functions in the period to which the plan relates.
elements.quote: A strategic plan is a plan setting out how the Commissioner proposes to exercise the Commissioner's functions in the period to which the plan relates

elements.requirement: The period to which a strategic plan relates must be not less than one year and not more than three years.
elements.quote: which must be not less than one year and not more than three years

elements.requirement: A strategic plan must in particular state the Commissioner's objectives and priorities for the period to which the plan relates.
elements.quote: state the Commissioner's objectives and priorities for the period to which the plan relates

elements.requirement: A strategic plan must in particular state any matters on which the Commissioner proposes to report under section 8 during the period to which the plan relates.
elements.quote: state any matters on which the Commissioner proposes to report under section 8 during that period

elements.requirement: A strategic plan must in particular state any other activities the Commissioner proposes to undertake during that period in the exercise of the Commissioner's functions.
elements.quote: state any other activities the Commissioner proposes to undertake during that period in the exercise of the Commissioner's functions

elements.requirement: The Commissioner must, before the end of the period to which a strategic plan relates (referred to as 'the current period'), prepare a strategic plan for a period immediately following the current period.
elements.quote: The Commissioner must, before the end of the period to which a strategic plan relates (“the current period”)— (a) prepare a strategic plan for a period immediately following the current period

elements.requirement: The Commissioner must, before the end of the current period, publish the strategic plan prepared for the period immediately following the current period.
elements.quote: before the end of the period to which a strategic plan relates (“the current period”)— (a) prepare a strategic plan for a period immediately following the current period, and (b) publish that plan

elements.requirement: The Commissioner may revise the strategic plan at any time during the period to which the plan relates.
elements.quote: At any time during the period to which a strategic plan relates, the Commissioner— (a) may revise the strategic plan

elements.requirement: The Commissioner must publish any revised plan.
elements.quote: must publish any revised plan

elements.requirement: In preparing or revising a strategic plan, the Commissioner must consult the Secretary of State.
elements.quote: In preparing or revising a strategic plan, the Commissioner must consult— (a) the Secretary of State

elements.requirement: In preparing or revising a strategic plan, the Commissioner must consult the Advisory Board established under section 12.
elements.quote: the Advisory Board established under section 12

elements.requirement: In preparing or revising a strategic plan, the Commissioner must consult such other persons as the Commissioner considers appropriate.
elements.quote: such other persons as the Commissioner considers appropriate

elements.requirement: The Commissioner must arrange for a copy of any plan or revised plan published under section 13 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 to be laid before Parliament.
elements.quote: The Commissioner must arrange for a copy of any plan (or revised plan) published under this section to be laid before Parliament.
